source_leads.title: A pyramid for a symbol - Cour Napoleon & Pyramid
use_for: glass, metal, paving, and pool context
captured_facts: Pyramid inaugurated on 29 March 1989.
Official key figures include height 21 m, base width 35 m, base area 1,000 m2, 675 diamond-shaped glass panes, and 118 triangular glass panes.
The courtyard design repeats square and triangle modules in the pyramid, pools, and paving.

source_leads.title: Map, entrances & directions - All roads lead to the Louvre
captured_facts: The Louvre lists four entrances: Pyramid, Carrousel, Richelieu, and Porte des Lions.
The official page links a downloadable museum map and an interactive floor plan.

source_leads.title: Getty CONA Full Record - Louvre Pyramid
captured_facts: Record lists the Louvre Pyramid as a glass and metal entrance in Cour Napoleon.
Address note gives coordinates 48.860854 N, 2.335812 E.
Dimensions listed include height 21.6 m, base sides 34 m, footprint 1,000 m2, 603 rhombus-shaped and 70 triangular glass segments.
